lines.zh: 我把脖子拉长，先探过那道矮墙。
lines.en: I stretch my neck like a piston to peek over the low wall.

lines.zh: 树苗在嘴里晃，叶尖扫着脚背。
lines.en: The sapling in my mouth sways, its leaves brushing my feet.

lines.zh: 一步一弹，我的颈节跟着伸缩。
lines.en: With every step, my neck segments telescope out and back.

lines.zh: 竹节踩碎了，脆响一路跟着我。
lines.en: Bamboo snaps underfoot, a crisp crack trailing behind me.

lines.zh: 蹄子陷进软土，我拽着脖子往前。
lines.en: My hooves sink in soft soil; I haul my long neck forward.

lines.zh: 苗圃边的土松，我走得格外轻。
lines.en: The soil by the sapling bed is loose, so I tread lightly.

lines.zh: 脖子缩回来时，肩膀才松一口气。
lines.en: When my neck retracts, my shoulders finally get to relax.

lines.zh: 我挑着石板路的边沿走，避开嫩芽。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the stone path to spare the young shoots.

lines.zh: 身后拖出一道浅浅的叶痕。
lines.en: A faint trail of leaves drags along behind me.

lines.zh: 我伸颈够了一下，那根藤蔓还太远。
lines.en: I stretch for that vine; it is still too far away.

lines.zh: 前后腿都短，我走得倒也稳当。
lines.en: My legs are short front and back, yet I walk steadily.

lines.zh: 竹林的风把我推向下一丛竹。
lines.en: The wind through the bamboo pushes me toward the next clump.

lines.zh: 我把脖子收到最短，像一节收好的活塞。
lines.en: I draw my neck in fully, like a piston slid home.

lines.zh: 树苗嚼到一半，我忘了自己在嚼。
lines.en: Halfway through a sapling, I forget that I am chewing.

lines.zh: 阳光落在颈节上，一节一节地暖。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my neck joints, warming them one by one.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己破开的蛋壳，纹路真好看。
lines.en: I stare at my cracked eggshell; its patterns are lovely.

lines.zh: 竹叶落进我的毛里，我不打算抖掉。
lines.en: Bamboo leaves settle in my fur; I do not plan to shake them off.

lines.zh: 没人来驯我，我就自己数叶脉。
lines.en: No one comes to tame me, so I count leaf veins alone.

lines.zh: 远处理苗的声音，我听得清楚。
lines.en: I can hear someone tending seedlings far away.

lines.zh: 我试着把脖子打个结，结果失败了。
lines.en: I try tying my neck in a knot, and fail completely.

lines.zh: 泥土的味道从蹄缝里升上来。
lines.en: The smell of soil rises from between my hooves.

lines.zh: 有只虫爬上我的颈，我屏住气。
lines.en: A bug climbs my neck, so I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我的影子被拉得很长，像另一根脖子。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long, like a second neck.

lines.zh: 这地方没有野生的同类，我习惯了。
lines.en: There are no wild kin here; I have gotten used to it.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在前腿上，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a foreleg and blink slowly.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还留着树苗的涩味。
lines.en: The bitter taste of sapling still lingers in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸到最长，去够嫩枝。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to its full length for that young branch.

lines.zh: 树苗的味道在舌根，一直没散。
lines.en: The taste of sapling sits at the root of my tongue.

lines.zh: 我数着自己颈上的节，一共八节。
lines.en: I count the joints in my neck. Eight of them.

lines.zh: 雨停了，我甩了甩背上的水。
lines.en: The rain stopped, so I shake the water off my back.

lines.zh: 你手里那棵树苗，是给我的吗？
lines.en: That sapling in your hand, is it meant for me?

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，鼻尖快碰到你的袖子。
lines.en: I stretch my neck until my nose nearly touches your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就把你看成一个树桩。
lines.en: Stand still long enough and I will mistake you for a stump.

lines.zh: 你身上有苗圃的土腥味，我认得。
lines.en: You smell of seedling beds; I recognize that earthy scent.

lines.zh: 我偏头看你，颈节咔地响了一下。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, and a neck joint clicks.

lines.zh: 你会用树苗换我的信任，对吧？
lines.en: You are going to trade saplings for my trust, right?

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着竹叶，刚刚穿过林子？
lines.en: Your boots are covered in bamboo leaves; were you in the grove?

lines.zh: 我把脖子绕到你侧边，想看清你的手。
lines.en: I loop my neck to your side to get a look at your hands.

lines.zh: 你不举树苗，我就只是看着。
lines.en: If you hold up no sapling, I will simply watch.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我下意识缩了缩脖子。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I flinch and pull my neck in.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里站了一会儿，凉快。
lines.en: I stand in your shadow a while; it is pleasantly cool.

lines.zh: 你身上没有刷怪蛋的气味，有点奇怪。
lines.en: You carry no spawn-egg smell at all, which is odd.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，想弄明白你要做什么。
lines.en: I stare into your eyes, trying to work out your intent.

lines.zh: 你要是蹲下，我会把鼻子凑得更近。
lines.en: Crouch down and I will bring my nose even closer.

lines.zh: 你把树苗举高，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Lift the sapling higher and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你身后没有别的同类，只有你。
lines.en: There are no others of my kind behind you. Only you.

lines.zh: 颈节被砍了一下，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Something cuts my neck joint and I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 我疼得把脖子收回壳里。
lines.en: It hurts so much that I pull my neck back into my shell.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肩胛，我踉跄半步。
lines.en: The blow lands on my shoulder and I stagger half a step.

lines.zh: 我的叶子被削掉一片，心里发慌。
lines.en: A leaf of mine is sliced off, and I panic.

lines.zh: 我往苗圃那边退，脚步乱了。
lines.en: I retreat toward the seedling bed with scrambling steps.

lines.zh: 伤口的土腥味让我自己都不安。
lines.en: The earthy smell of my wound unsettles even me.

lines.zh: 我低低叫了一声，脖子垂下来。
lines.en: I let out a low cry and let my neck droop.

lines.zh: 我撞到树干才停住，肩上一阵麻。
lines.en: I stop only by hitting a trunk, my shoulder numb.

lines.zh: 别砍我的颈，那里最软。
lines.en: Do not cut my neck; that is the softest part of me.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔伤处，尝到铁味。
lines.en: I lick the wound and taste iron.

lines.zh: 树苗一递过来，我的脖子先动了。
lines.en: The moment a sapling appears, my neck moves first.

lines.zh: 那截竹笋的香味，隔着几步就勾住我。
lines.en: That bamboo shoot's scent hooks me from several steps away.

lines.zh: 你把嫩枝晃了晃，我眼睛跟着转。
lines.en: You wiggle the tender branch and my eyes follow it.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，只差一点就够到叶尖。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out; the leaf tip is just out of reach.

lines.zh: 这棵小苗的根还湿着，刚拔的？
lines.en: These roots are still damp; did you pull it just now?

lines.zh: 我闻到竹子的清甜，脚就不听话了。
lines.en: I smell fresh bamboo sweetness and my feet stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 你把树苗举高，我踮起前蹄去够。
lines.en: You raise the sapling and I rise onto my front hooves.

lines.zh: 交换吧，你给苗，我给你信任。
lines.en: Let us trade: your sapling for a little of my trust.

lines.zh: 我围着那丛嫩竹转，舍不得走开。
lines.en: I circle the young bamboo clump, unwilling to leave it.

lines.zh: 叶子在风里一翻，我的心也跟着翻。
lines.en: A leaf turns in the wind and my heart turns with it.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的颈节，它弹了一下。
lines.en: You bump into my neck, and it springs back.

lines.zh: 我的脖子挡在路中间，像根横木。
lines.en: My neck lies across the path like a fallen beam.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先缩了缩头。
lines.en: We collide, and I am the first to duck my head.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄尖，我往旁边挪。
lines.en: You step on my hoof tip, so I shuffle aside.

lines.zh: 我的颈节夹住了你的袖子，抱歉。
lines.en: My neck joint has pinched your sleeve; my apologies.

lines.zh: 撞上来的时候，我听见骨节在响。
lines.en: At the moment of impact, I hear my joints creak.

lines.zh: 你推我，我推回去，谁也没动。
lines.en: You push, I push back, and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我们错身时，竹叶掉了一地。
lines.en: As we pass each other, bamboo leaves fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子转弯太慢，撞上了你。
lines.en: My long neck turns too slowly and bumps into you.

lines.zh: 你从我颈下钻过去，我低头看你。
lines.en: You duck beneath my neck, and I lower my head to watch.

lines.zh: 你递来的竹子，我叼去给她。
lines.en: The bamboo you hand me, I carry over to her.

lines.zh: 我们两根脖子绕在一起，打了个结。
lines.en: Our two necks twine together and tie themselves in a knot.

lines.zh: 她把树苗推回来，算是答应了。
lines.en: She nudges the sapling back, which counts as yes.

lines.zh: 竹林深处安静，我们并排站着。
lines.en: Deep in the bamboo grove it is quiet, and we stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我用颈节碰碰她的颈节，慢慢蹭。
lines.en: I touch my neck joint to hers and rub it slowly.

lines.zh: 她低头，我跟着低头，叶子在中间。
lines.en: She bows her head, I bow mine, a leaf between us.

lines.zh: 我们守着一小片苗圃，谁都不走。
lines.en: We guard a little seedling patch and neither of us leaves.

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的那截竹笋留给她。
lines.en: I save the tenderest bamboo shoot for her.

lines.zh: 她的脖子比我短一点，正好靠肩。
lines.en: Her neck is a little shorter than mine, just right to lean on.

lines.zh: 等小兽出来，这片林子就热闹了。
lines.en: Once the little one arrives, this grove will get lively.

lines.zh: 地上那棵树苗，我叼起来收好。
lines.en: That sapling on the ground, I pick up and tuck away.

lines.zh: 我把滚落的竹笋拢到脚边。
lines.en: I gather the rolled-away bamboo shoots to my feet.

lines.zh: 掉下的叶子我也捡，攒着有用。
lines.en: I collect fallen leaves too; they may come in handy.

lines.zh: 那枚蛋壳碎片，我含进嘴里带去窝。
lines.en: I take an eggshell shard in my mouth and carry it to the nest.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，把远处的苗勾过来。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to hook a distant seedling closer.

lines.zh: 拾起来的东西，我都塞在颈下。
lines.en: Everything I pick up gets stuffed beneath my neck.

lines.zh: 这根断枝还能种，我叼走了。
lines.en: This broken branch can still be planted, so I take it.

lines.zh: 有人掉了树苗，我替他捡一段路。
lines.en: Someone dropped a sapling; I carry it a while for them.

lines.zh: 我闻到土里的种子，用鼻子拱出来。
lines.en: I smell seeds in the soil and root them out with my nose.

lines.zh: 收集是我的习惯，哪怕只是一片叶。
lines.en: Collecting is my habit, even if it is one single leaf.

lines.zh: 那个影子在苗圃里动，我盯住了。
lines.en: That shape is moving in the seedling bed; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，先看清来的是什么。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to see exactly what is coming.

lines.zh: 谁在啃我的竹子？我找到它了。
lines.en: Who is gnawing my bamboo? I have found them.

lines.zh: 我颈节绷紧，朝那团动静转过去。
lines.en: My neck stiffens, and I turn toward the rustling.

lines.zh: 一只小东西溜过，我记下它的方向。
lines.en: A small thing slips past; I note which way it went.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，蹄子压着草不出声。
lines.en: I creep closer, hooves pressing the grass in silence.

lines.zh: 那东西碰了我的树苗，我不能不管。
lines.en: That thing touched my sapling; I cannot let it slide.

lines.zh: 我的脖子已经探到它头顶上方。
lines.en: My neck is already extended above its head.

lines.zh: 我把它圈在视线里，不再眨眼。
lines.en: I keep it inside my gaze and stop blinking.

lines.zh: 目标不大，我也不打算用力。
lines.en: The target is small, and I do not mean to use force.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压低，像压下去的活塞。
lines.en: I lower my neck like a piston pushed down.

lines.zh: 它退一步，我的颈节就伸一寸。
lines.en: It steps back once, and my neck extends an inch.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，蹄声很轻。
lines.en: I circle it with very quiet hoofbeats.

lines.zh: 竹叶挡着，我偏头找它的位置。
lines.en: Bamboo leaves block my view, so I tilt my head to locate it.

lines.zh: 我憋着气，等它先动。
lines.en: I hold my breath, waiting for it to make the first move.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的脖子就跟着转。
lines.en: The instant it moves, my neck swings after it.

lines.zh: 我不急，反正我够得着。
lines.en: No rush; my reach is long enough anyway.

lines.zh: 我把它逼到苗圃边上，退路不多。
lines.en: I crowd it to the seedling bed's edge, few ways out.

lines.zh: 颈节在皮里滑了一下，我准备好。
lines.en: A neck joint slides under my hide; I am ready.

lines.zh: 它还在犹豫，我先沉住气。
lines.en: It is still hesitating, so I steady my breathing.

lines.zh: 脖子弹出去，一下顶在它胸口。
lines.en: My neck fires out and strikes it square in the chest.

lines.zh: 我用颈节横扫，把它推开半米。
lines.en: I sweep with my neck joint and shove it back half a meter.

lines.zh: 前蹄踏下去，正好落在它脚边。
lines.en: I stamp a forehoof down, landing right beside its feet.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子撞它，它退了。
lines.en: I ram it with my extended neck, and it gives ground.

lines.zh: 竹枝被我甩过去，抽在它背上。
lines.en: I whip a bamboo branch across its back.

lines.zh: 我低头一顶，把它掀进草丛。
lines.en: I lower my head and flip it into the grass.

lines.zh: 颈节收回来再弹出，第二下更准。
lines.en: My neck retracts and fires again; the second hit lands true.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的边角，往旁边拖。
lines.en: I bite a corner of it and drag it aside.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我伸长脖子拦住去路。
lines.en: It tries to run; I stretch my neck across its path.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了三分力。
lines.en: I put only a third of my strength into that one.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋里滚出来，颈节还在收。
lines.en: I roll out of the spawn egg, my neck joints still retracting.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我第一眼看见的是苗圃。
lines.en: The shell splits, and the first thing I see is a seedling bed.

lines.zh: 这地方本没有野生的我，是你放下的。
lines.en: No wild Springling lived here; you are the one who placed me.

lines.zh: 我落地时脖子先着地，弹了两下。
lines.en: I land neck-first and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋的光散了，我站起来找树苗。
lines.en: The spawn egg's glow fades; I stand and look for saplings.

lines.zh: 我生来就认得竹子，没人教过。
lines.en: I knew bamboo from birth, and nobody taught me.

lines.zh: 脚下的草方块温温的，我站定了。
lines.en: The grass block under me is warm; I settle my feet.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的蛋液，伸长脖子张望。
lines.en: I shake off the egg fluid and crane my neck to look around.

lines.zh: 一出壳，我就想找棵苗啃。
lines.en: Fresh out of the shell, I already want a sapling to chew.

lines.zh: 专属的蛋方块裂了，我爬出来。
lines.en: My own egg block cracks open, and I clamber out.

lines.zh: 四周很陌生，我把脖子伸得很长。
lines.en: Everything is unfamiliar, so I stretch my neck out far.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里带出一点土腥味。
lines.en: I bring a faint smell of soil out of the egg with me.

lines.zh: 火燎到颈上的毛，我拼命往土里钻。
lines.en: Flame singes my neck fur and I dig desperately into the soil.

lines.zh: 从高处砸下来，我的颈节撞得发闷。
lines.en: Dropping from a height, my neck joints hit with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 水灌进颈管，我伸长脖子够空气。
lines.en: Water floods my neck canal; I stretch upward for air.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，蛋壳的记忆一闪。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, and a memory of eggshell flashes by.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进颈节，我缩了又缩。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my neck joint and I retract again and again.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进骨头，我的叶子发黑。
lines.en: A chill seeps into my bones and my leaves turn black.

lines.zh: 饿得颈节都软了，我啃不动干草。
lines.en: Hunger softens my neck joints; I cannot even chew dry grass.

lines.zh: 雷落在身边，我整条脖子都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and my whole neck goes stiff.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我伸长脖子也够不到土。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I stretch my neck and find no soil.
